name: bpo
title: BPO — Baseline / Proof / Outcome
description: Client delivery. Every claimed outcome traces to a dated baseline and a dated post-measure of the same metric, with confounders named.
use_when: Doing work for a client or a goal where you will later report what changed. Anything that ends in a report, a result, or a renewal conversation.
blurb: structures delivery (claiming an outcome you measured the start of)
